name: Pure Tones among Hills and Waters
material: Handscroll; ink and light color on paper
summary: Painted at age 68, this landscape is one of Xiao Yuncong’s most mature works. Extraordinary in its combination of fine details with bold brushstrokes and bluish washes, it is also one of his longest compositions in handscroll format, extending over 23 feet.
